title: Purair® SKY Ceiling Mounted Air Filtration Units
meta_title: Purair SKY Ceiling Filtration Units - Protect Lab Personnel & Environment
meta_description: The Purair® SKY ceiling mounted filtration units are designed to protect laboratory personnel and the environment in areas where hazardous substances are handled.
meta_keywords: ceiling filtration, air filtration, laboratory safety, hazardous substance handling
short_description: The Purair® SKY ceiling mounted filtration units are designed to protect laboratory personnel and the environment in areas where hazardous substances are handled.
full_description: Advanced carbon filtration technology. Multi-unit connection options. Ceiling mounted or hanging configurations. Energy efficiency. Enhanced Filtration. Central to the design of the Purair SKY Series is the Multiplex™ Filtration System developed to ensure universal protection in the work environment over the widest range of applications within the industry.
seo_content: The Purair SKY Series ceiling filtration units offer programmable humidity control, HEPA filtration, and energy-efficient operation to create a safe, clean work environment for a variety of laboratory and industrial applications including compounding, forensics, histology, pharmaceutical, and more.
features_data: Multiplex™ Filtration System for universal protection

structured_data.name: Purair® SKY Ceiling Mounted Air Filtration Units
structured_data.description: The Purair® SKY ceiling mounted filtration units are designed to protect laboratory personnel and the environment in areas where hazardous substances are handled.

page_content_sections.overview: Advanced carbon filtration technology. Multi-unit connection options. Ceiling mounted or hanging configurations. Energy efficiency. Enhanced Filtration. Central to the design of the Purair SKY Series is the Multiplex™ Filtration System developed to ensure universal protection in the work environment over the widest range of applications within the industry.
page_content_sections.specifications: Epoxy-coated steel construction, 120V 60Hz electrical, downflow airflow, 11 lbs carbon main filter, HEPA biological filter, HEPA filtration compliance, and Air Science Legacy Limited warranty.
page_content_sections.applications: The Purair SKY Series is designed for use in compounding, forensics, histology, pharmaceutical, powder fingerprinting, solvent cleaning, and other laboratory applications requiring hazardous substance handling.
page_content_sections.models: The Purair SKY Series is available in two models: SKY-24-A (26.4" x 26.4") and SKY-48-A (26.4" x 52.75").
